thread:
Sam: FYI - BlueRidge wants to push their renewal date and also asked for a short credit for downtime during onboarding. They say procurement needs a PO referencing the amendment before AP will accept the credit note.
customer-contact: Hi Sam, thanks for the call. We're requesting a 2-month extension to the annual term (new end date 2027-02-28) due to M&A transition. Also asking for a $12,000 credit for onboarding incidents in Feb. Need PO and signed amendment to process.
Priya: Noted. Current invoice INV-2026-11-15-06 for $240,000 covers 600 seats for 12 months. Renewal due 2027-12-31. We need to confirm pricing effect of extension + how the credit applies.
Janelle: Do they want term shift without changing seat count or price? If extension reduces annual period overlap we need to pro-rate.
customer-contact: Seat count remains 600. Extension is administrative; they want billing to show extended end date and apply a credit memo for $12,000 against the most recent invoice or as standalone credit note.
acct-bot: Invoice INV-2026-11-15-06: $240,000 paid via wire on 2026-11-16. Payment REF: WR-998877.
Sam: Legal angle - do we allow unilateral term extension? Legal-Ops: We typically allow mutual amendments. If customer signs amendment we can move dates. I'll need exact language and signatory.
Legal-Ops: I can draft a 2-line amendment: new term end date + credit memo reference. Need the exact credit amount and whether credit is cash refund vs credit to balance.
Priya: Policy: we issue credit memos only (no CC refunds for paid wires) unless finance approves. The credit memo can be applied to future invoices or refunded after escalation. Confirm customer accepts credit memo.
customer-contact: They accept a credit memo applied to next invoice. Procurement requires a PO referencing the amendment id in their AP system.
Janelle: Ok action list: (1) Priya to produce credit memo CM-2026-1203-draft for $12,000; (2) Sam/Legal to produce amendment doc and route for e-sign; (3) Sam to request PO number from customer to include in doc; (4) Billing to create revised invoice showing extended term and note AMEND-2041127788.
Priya: Creating CM draft now. Will include: original invoice ref, credit reason: onboarding downtime, credit amount $12,000, status: draft.
acct-bot: Draft credit memo created: CM-2026-1203-007 (status: draft).
Sam: Customer, please send PO # or confirm PO will reference AMEND-2041127788 so procurement can match.
customer-contact: PO will be created once amendment is in DocuSign. Procurement requires DocuSign link + final amount.
Legal-Ops: I'll push amendment to DocuSign with placeholder for PO and CM id. Link will be posted. ETA: 3-4 hours.
Priya: Billing note: once amendment signed we'll issue revised invoice RI-2026-1203-004 and a PDF credit note CM-2026-1203-007. We can include PO field in invoice description.
Janelle: Also flag finance for potential cash refund request should they escalate. @Finance please watch.
Sam: Thanks. Timeline: target amendment out today, PO expected within 48 hours, apply credit after PO and signed amendment. If PO delayed we'll discuss temporary hold.
customer-contact: Understood - procurement said 48h after they receive DocuSign. Will chase internally.
acct-bot: CM-2026-1203-007: status updated -> approved (pending apply).
Priya: CM applied to account and new invoice queued: RI-2026-1203-004.
Legal-Ops: Amendment sent to DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/BR-EXT-2041127788 (internal link).
Sam: Great work. If anything blocks PO or DocuSign flow tag me.
customer-contact: Signed and returned 2026-12-03 14:22 UTC. PO# BR-PO-334455 attached in return email.
Janelle: Received signed amendment and PO. Processing credit application now.
acct-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-1203-007: applied to account, remaining balance updated. Revised invoice RI-2026-1203-004 issued showing new end date 2027-02-28 and PO reference BR-PO-334455.
Sam: Closing loop - extension and credit applied, procurement happy. Follow-ups if any exceptions crop up. :tada:
